metadata.title: Surreal Hip-Hop Portrait with Miniature Figure

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a central subject with a miniature version of themselves interacting with their clothing or accessories against a solid vibrant background.
excludeWhen: minimalist or muted color palettes are preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a smiling man wearing a baseball cap and heavy jewelry, characterized by a surreal element where a tiny, identical version of the man sits on the brim of his hat. The lighting is bright and even, emphasizing textures of skin, metal, and fabric against a flat, saturated blue backdrop.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with hands framing the face
Miniature figure scaled to approximately 1/10th of the primary head size
High contrast between the white clothing/jewelry and the deep blue background
Symmetrical hand gestures pointing toward the temples
coreInvariants: Presence of a miniature human figure
High-key lighting with sharp details on jewelry and teeth
Direct eye contact or engagement with the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is centered, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame; miniature figure is placed off-center on the hat brim.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's wide, bright smile and diamond-encrusted teeth.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central smile, moves up to the eyes, follows the fingers pointing to the temples, and finally rests on the miniature figure on the hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample flat blue space surrounding the head and shoulders to provide breathing room for the busy central details.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright White (T-shirt, jewelry highlights, hat embroidery)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high value (brightness) in the foreground elements to create a pop-out effect.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to three primary hues: Blue, White, and Red

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in varying scales within a boxed container.
graphicDevices: Rectangular black and white warning label aesthetic

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for a warning label.
Standard professional grotesque for clean metadata presentation.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution studio portrait of a man with a wide smile, wearing a blue baseball cap, white t-shirt, and heavy silver/diamond jewelry against a solid royal blue background. Ensure a miniature version of the same man is sitting on the brim of the hat.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, centered black and white rectangular label at the top of the image containing bold, white, condensed sans-serif text in a stacked layout.

verificationChecks: Is the miniature figure clearly visible and scaled correctly?
Is the background a single flat color without gradients?
Are the jewelry and teeth rendered with high-specular highlights?
Is the text box centered at the top edge?

mustRedesign: Avoid specific brand logos on the hat
Do not replicate specific celebrity tattoos
Ensure the miniature figure is a generic likeness rather than a specific person

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the face and jewelry
Seamless integration of the miniature figure

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic lighting on the miniature figure that matches the main subject.
Verify the 'iced out' texture of the jewelry is sparkling.
Ensure the hands are anatomically correct and framing the face.
Confirm the background is a uniform, solid blue.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + [Solid Color Background] + [Miniature Subject Interaction] + [High-Key Lighting] + [Urban Jewelry/Streetwear]
